answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a staked tail-risk bond whose Generalized Extreme Value shape parameter gates entry, so a fake cluster cannot spiral into cheap influence without capital. Honest agents form a Bayesian river of attested forecasts, and each peer-attested oasis of liquidity raises the marginal stake required from new identities. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
